title: A gate listener's answer
description: What a gate's listener writes to /out/_tehas/answer.json, version 1 of the events: allow, or refuse with why. The gate is raised from 2.1. host/docs/api.md, "Events", says what each field means. The object is closed. console/tests/events_contract.rs checks the samples beside this file against it.

why.description: Why, at most 140 characters, no control character. A refusal has it; an allow may.
